    AI Overview
    Alexia Jayy was crowned the winner of The Voice Season 29 (Spring 2026), titled "Battle of Champions," on April 14, 2026. A member of Team Adam Levine, the 31-year-old singer secured the victory with a final performance of Aretha Franklin’s "I Never Loved a Man (The Way I Love You),". 
    Key Details of the Season 29 Finale (Spring 2026): 
    • Winner: Alexia Jayy
    • Coach: Adam Levine (his 4th win)
    • Runners-up: Liv Ciara (2nd, Team Kelly), Lucas West (3rd, Team Legend), Mikenley Brown (4th, Team Kelly)
    • Significance: Jayy is the first African-American female to win in the show's history.
    • Winning Single: "Rent Free," released April 15, 2026. 
    Note: There appears to be a separate "Season 26" mentioned in older, potentially mislabeled online content, but the April 2026 "Battle of Champions" finale concluded with Alexia Jayy as the winner.
